what_happened: All three countermodel grades, both transfer theorems, and a language-generic CountermodelEntry type compile-verified in two probe files on the first/second attempt: the gate theorem repackaged on explicit branch data (no kernel tableau rebuild) gives a kernel-checked gated-tableau entry with axioms [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound].

The plan's Lean Challenge Statements block cross-validated against the Goals identifier set and COMPILED against the project's own toolchain on the first attempt (lean-challenge-snapshot.sh 973 . --dry-run --compile, exit 0), confirming every pinned signature's namespaces resolve (PointTruth, GenericValidIn, Branch, TimeOrdering, ofFormula) before any implementation dispatch runs. Compile-checking the Challenge block at plan time is cheap and catches the namespace errors the research report itself hit twice.

All 8 non-final phases' first-draft Tier Justification lines claimed the no-suite sentinel, which validate-artifact.sh rejected as a false claim. Root cause measured: plan-file-scope-harvest.sh auto-appends typst/generated/status.typ to EVERY phase carrying a .lean edit (this repo declares it a coupled generated surface), and that path maps to two real suites (test-plan-file-scope-harvest.sh, test-validate-artifact.sh). So a Lean-repo phase's selector output is always MIXED even when every named path maps to nothing. Corrected all 8 to name the two real suites; plan now validates with 0 warnings.

Backtick-delimited identifier lists written as annotation prose inside a Files to modify entry (e.g. 'new: `A`, `B`, `C`') are read by validate-artifact.sh as a comma-joined second path and warned on in 3 phases. Fix: annotation prose in Files to modify blocks carries no backticks at all. Worth knowing for any plan whose deliverables are named declarations.

Pre-task baseline of scripts/check-module-invariants.sh exits 1 on a C16 roots-baseline FAIL: 5 entries above the pinned ceiling in scripts/c16-roots-baseline.txt, all pre-existing and all out of this task's scope (BimodalLibTest.DiagnosticsTest docBlame x1; BimodalTools.CanonicalWire.Json defsWithUnderscore x3; BimodalTools.ForwardProofGenerator defsWithUnderscore x1; BimodalTools.JsonParse docBlame x8; BimodalTools.TableauBridge docBlame x4). Captured at commit a76a46f6e before any edit, so Phase 9's delta reading has a real baseline. Consequence for this task: BimodalLibTest IS a counted root, so every declaration in the Phase 8 test modules must carry a docstring or the ceiling grows.

All seven research probe files (P1-P7) survived in the session scratchpad at probe/, so Phases 1, 2, 5 and 6 start from compile-verified source rather than re-derivation. Phase 1's module built green with --wfail on first attempt.

lakefile.toml line 34 declares defaultTargets = ["FormalSystem"] only; BimodalLib, BimodalLibTest and BimodalTools are deliberately absent (header comment at lines 6-19). Measured: a bare guarded 'lake build --wfail' ran 3018 jobs and did NOT elaborate BimodalLib.Countermodel, while 'lake build BimodalLib --wfail' ran 3046 and did. Consequence: in THIS repository a bare full 'lake build' is a strictly WEAKER phase-end gate than the plan's scoped invocation, not a stronger one. The phase-end full-build gate is therefore discharged here as 'lake build BimodalLib BimodalLibTest --wfail', which transitively builds FormalSystem and every downstream dependent of the modules this task adds.

Phase 2 axiom measurement came in STRICTLY SMALLER than the plan's predicted [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound]: not_genericConsequenceIn_of_le -> [propext]; not_genericConsequenceIn_ofFormula -> [propext, Quot.sound]; genericConsequenceIn_nil -> [propext, Quot.sound]; inferenceProfile_map_ofFormula -> [propext]. No Classical.choice anywhere, because both transfer theorems are explicit terms rather than classical tactic proofs.

Phase 2's first build failed: 'simpa [inferenceProfile] using profileP_ofFormula' left the goal as HasProfile.profile (ofFormula phi) = HasProfile.profile phi, which profileP_ofFormula does not match syntactically because the class projection does not unfold under simp. Fixed forward with two named rfl lemmas (hasProfile_eq_profileF / hasProfile_eq_profileP) added to the simp set, rather than with an inline 'show' -- 'show' is linted in this package and CI builds with --wfail. The two lemmas are deliberately NOT marked @[simp], to keep the class projection opaque elsewhere.

Phase 3's Scope Hypothesis predicted ~21 registrable hand-built refutations (16 class-tag plus 5 PlusValid). Measured by exact-name sweep: 20 declarations in the three sharpness modules match a class-tag non-validity shape, but 6 of those are schematic *_minFrameClass_sharp statements over a quantified fc with an fc < C hypothesis, which cannot be filed at a fixed frameClass; and the remaining 14 concrete declarations collapse to 6 entries once the plan's own MAXIMAL-class-only filing rule is applied (ZTime {density, dense_indicator}, Dense {prior_U_gap, sep}, RTime {prior_UZ, z1}). With the 5 PlusValid rows the landed total is 11, not 21. The hypothesis double-counted exactly what the maximal-class rule exists to collapse: Base/Dense/RTime duplicates of the same inference.

The research report recorded refute_determined's bounded object as 'the paper's Determined schema -- not formalized', implying a bare note with no nearMiss. Reading PlusNonValidities.lean's own docstring found that the POSITIVE half IS a theorem: FormalSystem.PlusLanguage.determined_of_deterministic (PlusDeterminism.lean:180) validates the schema on every Deterministic frame. That declaration is exactly what dropping the side condition refutes, so the row names a real declaration and 4 of the 5 stability refutations carry a resolvable nearMiss instead of 3.
